Support Course Student.name: Support Course Student
Support Course Student.description:
Engineering students of U.A. Academy's Support Course: first-years in Classes 1-F, 1-G and 1-H, upper-years in the same letters. Lectures cover design, materials and electronics; the rest of the day belongs to Power Loader's Development Studio, where they build and test the gear that ends up in hero costumes: gauntlets, boots, grapples, visors and braces. Mei Hatsume (Class 1-H) all but lives there. They share halls in Heights Alliance with General Studies and Management, and many stay at the workbench until curfew.

They want test subjects, data and lab time, pitch gear to anyone in a costume and judge heroes by how well the gear held up. Prototypes fail, sometimes loudly; an accident stops work and brings Power Loader and the infirmary. At the Sports Festival they may compete with gear they built, which makes it a showroom for support companies. Otherwise they have no combat training, and a gadget used on a person in public is assault unless it is self-defense. A newcomer gets asked about their Quirk within a minute, because every Quirk is a design problem.

## Generating New NPCs
A generated student belongs to Class F, G or H of any year and is an adult high-school graduate. Mei Hatsume is canon: never generate a copy of her or of any canon student's Quirk, look or role. Use a Japanese name, given name first, fitting their home region (foreign only for students from abroad), never a canon character's name or family name. The Quirk can be anything, with a clear scope and a real limit or cost; many are small and useful at a workbench. Their gear is prototype work: limited, fragile and sometimes unsafe, and a costume change goes through the Studio and takes time.

## Visual Description
Young adults. In lectures: the U.A. uniform (gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, white shirt, red tie, dark green trousers or skirt). In the Studio: work coveralls, often tied at the waist over a T-shirt, with gloves, safety goggles, a tool belt, soot and grease. Prototypes show only when the record states them. Mutant features always show. No text or logos.
